outcome.Summary: Created package `tmpl` (tmpl/tmpl.go, stdlib only) with `Render(src, data)`. It copies text verbatim, treats `{{{{` as a literal `{{` (not a tag start), parses `{{ name | filter | filter:"arg" }}` tags with whitespace-insensitive names (incl. `.field` segments into nested map[string]any), formats values per spec (missing/nil → ""), and applies the filters upper, lower, trim, default:"x", truncate:"N" (rune-based with …), and html. Errors (unknown filter naming the filter, missing/extra args, bad/non-integer/negative truncate arg, unterminated/empty tag, bad name, non-map indexing with the full dotted name) return a non-nil error with empty output. Added tmpl/tmpl_test.go covering all behaviors including escapes, Unicode truncation, and a mixed document; `go vet ./... && go test ./...` passes.
